payload.objective: Find the molecular mechanism that best explains the loss of function of WAS-p.Thr45Met (WAS, UniProt P42768) and test it with one targeted computational test.
payload.question: For a pathogenic missense variant in an immune-deficiency gene, which molecular mechanism best explains the loss of function, and does a targeted computational test change the conclusion that the starting evidence suggested?

payload.statement: ClinVar classifies NM_000377.3(WAS):c.134C>T (p.Thr45Met) as Pathogenic (criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts; 2 of 4 stars; 11 submissions) for WAS-related disorder / X-linked severe congenital neutropenia.
payload.strength: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts (2 of 4 stars)

payload.statement: UniProtKB natural variant VAR_008106 at residue 45 (T to M) is annotated for Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome and X-linked severe congenital neutropenia, with 5 publications cited.
The WAS protein residue 45 lies within the WH1/EVH1 domain (residues 39-148) in the UniProtKB annotation, which is an computational-prediction-based domain assignment.
AlphaMissense gives p.Thr45Met of P42768 a pathogenicity score of 0.5907, classed as likely pathogenic.
payload.strength: computational prediction, not validated for clinical use

payload.statement: EVE gives p.Thr45Met of P42768 a score of 0.679, classed as pathogenic, and popEVE gives -4.341 (more negative = more deleterious).
payload.strength: computational prediction, not validated for clinical use

payload.statement: In the only experimental structure observing residue 45 (solution NMR of the human WASP/WIP complex), no non-solvent ligand is bound.
AlphaFold DB model AF-P42768-F1 covers the full 502-residue sequence with mean pLDDT 69.38.
In a Syrian-Lebanese family with X-linked thrombocytopenia, affected men carried the missense C168T (Thr45Met) mutation in exon 2 of the WASP gene.
No functional assay in the record covers residue 45 (functional_assays_covering_residue = 0), so no measured effect of T45M on WASP activity, stability or binding is available.
payload.why_it_matters: Without a measured effect, the stability and interface hypotheses cannot be separated by data already in hand.

payload.statement: The only experimental structure observing residue 45 (9S9X) has no reference-versus-mutant comparison, and it is unknown whether T45 contacts WIP or another partner in it.
payload.why_it_matters: Whether residue 45 is at a protein interface or buried in the fold decides which mechanism class the variant belongs to.

payload.statement: T45M destabilises the WH1/EVH1 fold: the larger hydrophobic methionine at a Thr position perturbs local packing and hydrogen bonding, lowering folding stability and reducing functional WASP levels.
payload.would_refute: A predicted folding free-energy change near zero (|ddG| below about 1 kcal/mol) for T45M in the stability test.
payload.label: agent-generated hypothesis
payload.rank_rationale: Pathogenic classification and several computational pathogenicity scores (AlphaMissense, EVE) bear on loss of function, and the residue sits in the WH1 domain, but no stability measurement exists yet.

payload.statement: T45M removes or alters a surface contact of the WH1 domain with a partner protein (for example WIP), so the mutant WASP fails to bind its partner and is not stabilised or recruited to its site of action.
payload.would_refute: A structural context test that finds residue 45 buried in the core, away from any partner interface, with no interface membership.
payload.label: agent-generated hypothesis
payload.rank_rationale: The residue is inside the WH1 domain, which mediates partner binding, and a WASP/WIP complex structure observes it, but no contact to WIP is shown in the record.

payload.description: FoldX predicted folding free-energy change of T45M on the AlphaFold model. A destabilising value supports H1 (stability_folding); a neutral value weakens H1 and leaves H2 in play.
payload.expected_learning_reasoning: A destabilising value would move H1 to first place; a neutral value would move H2 to first place. Stability does not test H2 directly, so the result separates the two only partly.
payload.feasibility_reasoning: list_available_tests reports the FoldX state for this substitution as ok, can_run true, 0 compute seconds and 2 tool calls.
controls: Within-site comparison: the same predictor for the other substitutions reported at this residue.
Applicability control: the model confidence (pLDDT) at the residue, because FoldX on a low-confidence region is not interpretable.

payload.description: Predicted pocket and predicted protein-protein interface membership of residue 45 on the AlphaFold model (P2Rank and ProtVar). Interface membership supports H2; absence weakens H2.
payload.expected_learning_reasoning: A predicted interface would favour H2 and a buried position would favour H1. ProtVar reports interface state not_covered for this residue, so the interface result may be empty and not informative.
payload.feasibility_reasoning: Can run now, 0 compute seconds, 2 tool calls. The ProtVar interface state is not_covered, so the interface readout may return nothing.
controls: Rank control: the rank and probability of the pocket among all predicted pockets of the model.
Confidence control: mean pLDDT of the pocket residues.

payload.description: Reference versus variant structure prediction of the 29-158 construct. Would give RMSD and contact changes at the site.
payload.expected_learning_reasoning: Structure predictors are not validated for single substitutions, so a small change would not separate H1 from H2.

payload.description: Ligand contact of residue 45 in experimental structures. Would bear on ligand_binding only, which is not one of the current hypotheses.
payload.expected_learning_reasoning: The test cannot discriminate H1 or H2: it is not tested for stability and has no ligand-bound structure covering the residue.

payload.text:
## Question
By what molecular mechanism does WAS-p.Thr45Met (UniProt P42768) lose function, and what one computational test best discriminates the candidate mechanisms? [E1]

## Evidence
ClinVar lists c.134C>T (p.Thr45Met) as Pathogenic with multiple submitters and no conflicts [E1]. UniProtKB annotates the same change as natural variant VAR_008106 with five cited publications [E2]. Residue 45 lies in the WH1/EVH1 domain (residues 39-148) [E3]. AlphaMissense gives a score of 0.5907 and EVE gives 0.679, both computational [E4][E5]. The only experimental structure observing residue 45 (9S9X, NMR of the WASP/WIP complex) contains no ligand [E6]. The AlphaFold model has mean pLDDT 69.38 across the full chain [E7]. A primary report describes the change in an X-linked thrombocytopenia family [E8]. No functional assay covers residue 45 [G1], and no structure shows whether it contacts WIP [G2].

## Agent-generated hypotheses
H1 (stability_folding): T45M destabilises the WH1 fold [H1]. H2 (protein_interaction): T45M removes a surface contact with a partner such as WIP [H2].

## Tests considered and the choice
Four candidates were recorded [T1][T2][T3][T4]. I chose T1, the FoldX stability test, because it runs without approval and gives a numeric value for H1 [T1]. The structural context test [T2] was deferred because its interface readout is not covered for this residue. The structure comparison [T3] needs approval and the live predictor is unavailable. The ligand contact test [T4] cannot run.

## Result
FoldX predicts +3.56 kcal/mol for T45M at a confidently predicted residue (pLDDT 96.62) [E9]. The other substitution at this residue, T45R, is predicted at +7.43 kcal/mol [E11]. missense3d returns Neutral [E10].

## Updated decision
H1 stays favoured [D1]. The value exceeds the 2.0 kcal/mol threshold [E9], but the missense3d call disagrees [E10]. H2 is unchanged because a stability test cannot assess an interface [H2].

## Uncertainty and validation still needed
FoldX on a predicted model carries errors near 1 kcal/mol, and the threshold is a display bin, not a validated cutoff [T1]. The calculation is for the monomer, not the WASP/WIP complex. No measured stability or binding data exist.

## Next experiment
Run the structural context test [T2] to check whether residue 45 sits in a predicted WIP interface or in the buried core [NE1]. Consistent core placement would strengthen H1; an interface placement would move the favour to H2.
